description: Install Tailscale and bring it up. Captures the browser login URL so you can authenticate the server.

steps.description: Install Tailscale using the official script (only if not already installed).
Bring Tailscale up (runs in the background) and print the login URL if authentication is needed.
steps.run: sudo sh -c 'nohup tailscale up >/tmp/ts-up.log 2>&1 & sleep 4; cat /tmp/ts-up.log; true'

uninstall.description: Log this server out of your tailnet and stop it.
uninstall.run: sudo tailscale logout 2>/dev/null || true; sudo tailscale down 2>/dev/null || true
